titulo: ‘The Pacific is not for sale’: outcry after US holds first deep sea mining lease sale near American Samoa
cuerpo: Multi-million dollar sale comes despite a federal judge in Hawaii voiding the environmental clearance it had been given to proceed The US has carried out its first ever deep-sea mining lease sales off the coast of American Samoa, despite an adverse court ruling earlier this week and mounting local opposition. The sales took place on Thursday in a live-streamed auction of 12.7m hectares (31.5m acres) of seabed off the US territory’s coast marked for mineral exploration. Two areas of the Pacific archipelago were sold for $3m each to Wetstone US Ventures, the only bidder, according to a spokesperson for the Marine Minerals Administration (MMA). Continue reading...
